signals.title: Doornpan Farm near Ottosdal (farm area, approx.): woman, 55, attacked at farm gate, died, 5 Oct
signals.content: Reports place the attack on Hannetjie van Zyl, 55, at the gate to Doornpan Farm, outside Ottosdal, on the evening of Monday 5 October; the saved SAPS statement does not itself give the incident date. Her husband took her to hospital in Klerksdorp, where police say she died. The Klerksdorp Record puts the attack at about 19:00, says she was hit repeatedly on the head and neck with an iron bar and that her handbag and phone were taken, and says she died on the way to hospital. Police say two men, aged 32 and 33, were arrested after a witness identified them, and a third suspect is still being sought. Accounts differ: Platinum Weekly, quoting police, gives the two accused's ages as 28 and 29, says they face murder and robbery charges, and says they appeared in the Bloemhof Periodical Court on 8 October, with bail applications set for 15 October; the SAPS statement named the Ottosdal Magistrate's Court. The DA and the VF Plus criticised the police response; the DA says police took an hour to arrive.

signals.title: Ipelegeng, Schweizer-Reneke (Kgaka St, approx.): man, 22, found stabbed dead, 9 Oct
signals.content: Taung Daily News reports that Atlholang Theteletsa, 22, was found with multiple stab wounds lying on Kgaka Street in Ipelegeng after 20:00 on Friday 9 October, and that paramedics confirmed he had died at the scene, according to police spokesperson Sgt Kelebogile Morake. A 25-year-old man was caught by members of the Ipelegeng Community Police Forum at a shop in Schweizer-Reneke on Saturday 10 October. He appeared in the Schweizer-Reneke court on 12 October on a murder charge, and the case was postponed to 29 October for a formal bail application. Police say the circumstances are not yet clear. The report is in Setswana; this is a translation. No SAPS statement was found.

signals.title: Seweding Village, Mahikeng (village only, approx.): man, 37, dies in fight with girlfriend's brother, 17 Oct
signals.content: SAPS says a 37-year-old man died in Seweding Village, Mmabatho, in the early hours of Saturday 17 October. Police called to a complaint at about 00:45 found his body, and paramedics declared him dead. Police say preliminary investigation indicates he jumped over a fence into a home and assaulted his girlfriend, and that her 47-year-old brother intervened; the confrontation between the two men led to his death. Police have not said how he died. SABC, quoting spokesperson Adele Myburgh, says the suspect has been arrested and is expected in the Mmabatho Magistrate's Court. Accounts differ on the day: SABC says Sunday; the police statement says Saturday 17 October.

signals.title: Modimola Village, Mahikeng (village only, approx.): man, 37, stabbed dead, 17 Oct
signals.content: SAPS says a 37-year-old man was stabbed at Modimola Village, Mmabatho, at about 04:00 on Saturday 17 October. A woman told police a 22-year-old family member came home at about 03:00 and broke the window of the room where she and the man were sleeping; the man went outside to confront him and they fought. She went to neighbours for help and, on returning, found him on the ground with stab wounds; paramedics declared him dead. A 22-year-old suspect was arrested and is expected in the Mmabatho Magistrate's Court on a murder charge. The same police statement reported the Seweding killing that night; police say the two are unrelated.
